# Hello World & Struktur Program

## Anatomi Program Go

```go
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
    fmt.Println("Hello, World!")
}
```

Setiap program Go yang bisa dieksekusi terdiri dari:

### 1. `package main`
Baris pertama mendeklarasikan **package**. Package `main` adalah paket khusus yang memberitahu compiler bahwa ini adalah program yang dapat dijalankan (bukan library).

### 2. `import`
Mengimpor package yang dibutuhkan. Package `fmt` (format) menyediakan fungsi untuk input/output.

```go
// Import satu package
import "fmt"

// Import banyak package
import (
    "fmt"
    "math"
    "strings"
)
```

### 3. `func main()`
Fungsi `main()` adalah titik masuk program. Go akan menjalankan fungsi ini pertama kali saat program dieksekusi.

## Fungsi-Fungsi fmt

### `fmt.Print` — Cetak tanpa newline
```go
fmt.Print("Hello")
fmt.Print(" World")
// Output: Hello World
```

### `fmt.Println` — Cetak dengan newline otomatis
```go
fmt.Println("Hello, World!")
fmt.Println("Baris kedua")
// Output:
// Hello, World!
// Baris kedua
```

### `fmt.Printf` — Cetak dengan format
```go
name := "Budi"
age := 25
fmt.Printf("Nama: %s, Umur: %d\n", name, age)
// Output: Nama: Budi, Umur: 25
```

### `fmt.Sprintf` — Format ke string (tidak dicetak)
```go
result := fmt.Sprintf("PI = %.2f", 3.14159)
fmt.Println(result)
// Output: PI = 3.14
```

## Tabel Format Verbs

| Verb | Tipe | Contoh Input | Output |
|---|---|---|---|
| `%s` | string | `"Go"` | `Go` |
| `%d` | integer | `42` | `42` |
| `%f` | float | `3.14` | `3.140000` |
| `%.2f` | float (2 desimal) | `3.14159` | `3.14` |
| `%t` | boolean | `true` | `true` |
| `%v` | nilai default | `[]int{1,2}` | `[1 2]` |
| `%T` | tipe data | `42` | `int` |
| `%p` | pointer address | `&x` | `0xc000...` |
| `%b` | binary | `10` | `1010` |
| `%x` | hexadecimal | `255` | `ff` |
| `%q` | quoted string | `"Go"` | `"Go"` |

## Contoh Lengkap

```go
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
    name := "Golang"
    version := 1.22
    isAwesome := true

    fmt.Printf("Bahasa: %s\n", name)
    fmt.Printf("Versi: %.2f\n", version)
    fmt.Printf("Keren? %t\n", isAwesome)
    fmt.Printf("Tipe name: %T\n", name)

    // Sprintf untuk membuat string
    msg := fmt.Sprintf("%s v%.2f", name, version)
    fmt.Println(msg)
}
```

**Output:**
```
Bahasa: Golang
Versi: 1.22
Keren? true
Tipe name: string
Golang v1.22
```

# Hello World & Program Structure

## Anatomy of a Go Program

```go
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
    fmt.Println("Hello, World!")
}
```

Every executable Go program consists of:

### 1. `package main`
The first line declares the **package**. The `main` package is special — it tells the compiler this is an executable program (not a library).

### 2. `import`
Imports needed packages. The `fmt` (format) package provides input/output functions.

```go
// Import a single package
import "fmt"

// Import multiple packages
import (
    "fmt"
    "math"
    "strings"
)
```

### 3. `func main()`
The `main()` function is the program entry point. Go executes this function first when the program runs.

## The fmt Functions

### `fmt.Print` — Print without newline
```go
fmt.Print("Hello")
fmt.Print(" World")
// Output: Hello World
```

### `fmt.Println` — Print with automatic newline
```go
fmt.Println("Hello, World!")
fmt.Println("Second line")
// Output:
// Hello, World!
// Second line
```

### `fmt.Printf` — Print with formatting
```go
name := "Budi"
age := 25
fmt.Printf("Name: %s, Age: %d\n", name, age)
// Output: Name: Budi, Age: 25
```

### `fmt.Sprintf` — Format to string (not printed)
```go
result := fmt.Sprintf("PI = %.2f", 3.14159)
fmt.Println(result)
// Output: PI = 3.14
```

## Format Verbs Table

| Verb | Type | Example Input | Output |
|---|---|---|---|
| `%s` | string | `"Go"` | `Go` |
| `%d` | integer | `42` | `42` |
| `%f` | float | `3.14` | `3.140000` |
| `%.2f` | float (2 decimals) | `3.14159` | `3.14` |
| `%t` | boolean | `true` | `true` |
| `%v` | default value | `[]int{1,2}` | `[1 2]` |
| `%T` | data type | `42` | `int` |
| `%p` | pointer address | `&x` | `0xc000...` |
| `%b` | binary | `10` | `1010` |
| `%x` | hexadecimal | `255` | `ff` |
| `%q` | quoted string | `"Go"` | `"Go"` |

## Complete Example

```go
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
    name := "Golang"
    version := 1.22
    isAwesome := true

    fmt.Printf("Language: %s\n", name)
    fmt.Printf("Version: %.2f\n", version)
    fmt.Printf("Awesome? %t\n", isAwesome)
    fmt.Printf("Type of name: %T\n", name)

    // Sprintf to build a string
    msg := fmt.Sprintf("%s v%.2f", name, version)
    fmt.Println(msg)
}
```

**Output:**
```
Language: Golang
Version: 1.22
Awesome? true
Type of name: string
Golang v1.22
```
starterCode:
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	name := "Gopher"
	age := 15
	height := 1.75
	isLearning := true

	// Gunakan format verbs yang berbeda / Use different format verbs
	fmt.Printf("Nama: %s\n", name)
	fmt.Printf("Umur: %d tahun\n", age)
	fmt.Printf("Tinggi: %.2f meter\n", height)
	fmt.Printf("Sedang belajar Go: %t\n", isLearning)
	fmt.Printf("Tipe data name: %T\n", name)

	// Coba Sprintf
	profile := fmt.Sprintf("%s (%d tahun)", name, age)
	fmt.Println(profile)
}

Karena package ini menandai program sebagai executable, bukan library
Karena package ini otomatis menambahkan semua import
Karena semua variabel global harus berada di package ini
options_en: Because only this package may use `fmt`
Because this package marks the program as an executable rather than a library
Because this package automatically adds all imports
Because all global variables must live in this package

options_id: Menjadi titik masuk pertama saat program dijalankan
options_en: It defines which package will be imported
It is the first entry point when the program runs
It converts all output into strings
It determines the default type of all variables
